landing.name: Landing page
landing.desc: One page with one goal: calls, bookings or sign-ups. For new businesses, one main service or an ad campaign.

website.name: Business website
website.desc: Up to 10 pages included (home, services, areas, about, contact). Extra pages for more services or suburbs.

options.name: Signature design
options.desc: Custom design with motion and interactive sections: an animated video hero, up to 10 sections with scroll effects, sliders or carousels, up to 4 video sections, custom icons, refined together until you approve it. Same speed and SEO foundation as Essential; respects reduced-motion settings. Default (free) is Essential: a proven layout in their logo, colours and fonts with subtle animations.

options.name: Persuasive copy & slogan
options.desc: We write every page: a memorable slogan, attention-grabbing headlines and persuasive text using buyer psychology, also targeted at what customers search for. Default (free): client sends their text or notes, we polish it or writes clear, professional text from the notes.

options.name: Stock photos
options.desc: Real licensed photos picked to match the business. Default (free): client's own photos, optimised, or natural, realistic AI photos made to match the business if they have none.

options.name: Custom art & illustrations
options.desc: Artwork created only for this brand: illustrations, characters and scenes in its own style.

options.name: Professional photoshoot
options.desc: A professional photographer shoots the team, work and premises, then edits and retouches the best shots for the website and social media. Price from $350; the final price depends on the city and is confirmed after a chat.

options.name: Simple content editor
options.desc: Edit text, photos, prices and opening hours yourself in a simple online editor. Free to run, nothing to update. Includes a 30-minute training video.

options.name: WordPress
options.desc: The WordPress dashboard: pages, blog, media and plugins. Needs WordPress hosting and regular updates, so a support plan is recommended. Includes training.

options.name: Domain + hosting, 1 year
options.desc: .com.au domain registered in the client's name plus 12 months hosting and SSL. Default (free): client already has domain and hosting.

options.name: Care plan
options.desc: For sites that rarely change. Domain (.com.au in the client's name), hosting, SSL, monthly security checks and vulnerability updates, weekly backups, uptime monitoring, fixes if something breaks, and 3 updates a month. One update = changes to one page (new or edited text, new photos, or changed prices or opening hours), sent in one request and done within 3 business days. Cancel anytime.

options.name: Care Plus plan
options.desc: For businesses that update prices, photos or offers. Everything in Care, plus 6 updates a month (unused updates carry over to the next month), booking, forms and payments checked monthly, and a monthly report (visitors, enquiries, Google). One update = changes to one page (new or edited text, new photos, or changed prices or opening hours), sent in one request and done within 3 business days. Cancel anytime.

options.name: Growth plan
options.desc: For businesses that want more customers from Google and AI search. Everything in Care Plus, plus 10 updates a month, 1 new page or blog post written each month, monthly SEO and AI search optimisation (page titles, keywords and structured data improved so Google and AI tools like ChatGPT understand the business), and a written list of improvement ideas every 3 months. One update = changes to one page (new or edited text, new photos, or changed prices or opening hours), sent in one request and done within 3 business days. Cancel anytime.

options.name: Online booking
options.desc: Customers pick a time online and get email/SMS reminders.

options.name: Payments & deposits
options.desc: Card payments or deposits with Stripe or Square.

options.name: Logo & mini brand kit
options.desc: Logo, icon and favicon, 4–6 brand colours, 2 fonts, button and photo style, social profile image. 3 concepts to choose from.

options.name: Blog
options.desc: Client posts news and tips; each post can rank on Google.

options.name: Business email
options.desc: you@business.com.au on Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 (their subscription paid separately).

options.name: Smart quote form
options.desc: A step-by-step questionnaire for your trade (e.g. rooms, suburb, dates, budget) with photo or file upload, so you get qualified leads instead of 'how much?' messages.

options.name: CRM setup
options.desc: Every enquiry and booking goes automatically into a CRM (customer list + sales pipeline). HubSpot free plan, Zoho, Pipedrive or the CRM you already use.

options.name: Online store
options.desc: Sell products online: up to 20 products, cart and checkout, shipping rules, order emails (Shopify or Stripe).

options.name: Email marketing
options.desc: Newsletter signup on the site, connected to Mailchimp or similar, with an automatic welcome email.

options.name: Google reviews on your site
options.desc: Your Google reviews shown on the site, plus a review link and QR code to collect more.

options.name: Ads & conversion tracking
options.desc: Track calls, forms and bookings as conversions in Google Analytics, Google Ads and Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Pixel, so you see which ads bring customers.

options.name: WhatsApp chat button
options.desc: A button that opens a WhatsApp chat with you, on every page.

options.name: AI assistant
options.desc: Answers customer questions and takes enquiries 24/7, trained on your services, prices and FAQs. From $230, plus AI usage fees charged by the AI provider.

options.name: Custom AI agent
options.desc: A chat with a job: asks customers the right questions and hands back a finished quote, plan or report as a PDF, like the Webumi website planner. Priced after a chat.

options.name: Automations
options.desc: Enquiries, invoices and follow-ups sent automatically. Priced after a chat.

options.name: Rush delivery
options.desc: About half the usual time. +25% on the build (not on domain & hosting).

options.name: Express delivery
options.desc: Top priority: landing page live in 1–2 business days, business website in 5 business days, once text and photos are received. +50% on the build (not on domain & hosting).

support: For 30 days after launch, issues with the agreed functionality are fixed at no extra cost. After that: a monthly plan with a set number of updates a month. One update = changes to one page (new or edited text, new photos, or changed prices or opening hours), sent in one request and done within 3 business days.

process: Tell us about your business (Day 1) → Fixed quote & agreement (Within 1 business day) → Homepage design (Days 2–3) → Website plan (Days 2–3) → Design & copy (Week 1) → Preview before launch (Week 1–2) → Go live (Week 1–2) → After launch (30 days)
payment: 50% to start, 50% at launch; Express 100% upfront; support plans monthly from 30 days after launch.
